Hi Tessa,

We're kicking off the vendor activation for Redwood as part of our PLG tooling expansion. Legal wants DPA + link to your latest SOC 2 report, and Procurement needs the list of subprocessors and a brief note on data residency/egress.

Can you send:
- Executable DPA (or redline path)
- SOC 2 report (link is fine)
- Current subprocessor list (CSV preferred)
- PO process and invoice remit instructions (who to invoice, PO number format, payment terms)

We aim to have the vendor in our finance system by COB next Thursday (2028-11-09). If you have award/discount codes related to PLG credits, flag them here.

Thanks —
Emma Cole
Sr. Procurement Manager, Uplift Technology

Hi Emma —

Thanks for the checklist. Attaching our current onboarding bundle: Redwood_DPA_v3.1.pdf, subprocessor list (subprocessors_2028-11.csv), and a W9 for finance. SOC 2 is available at the link below (read-only).

Quick notes:
- DPA: The PDF attached is our standard DPA; we can accept limited redlines on sections for termination and data return. If your legal team needs a tracked redline, we can start a DocuSign redline cycle.
- Subprocessors: The CSV lists cloud infra, monitoring, and analytics partners and the regions where they process data. We include data residency notes in the second column.
- PO/invoice: Please route PO to invoices@redwood.ai. Invoices should include PO number in the subject — format UPL-<YYYY>-<####>. Net 30 standard; we can discuss earlier payment for commit-based Dedicated contracts.

Links/attachments included:
- SOC2: https://reports.redwood.ai/soc2/2028-report
- DocuSign (if you want to sign DPA online): https://docusign.net/embeddedSigning/abcd-efgh-2028

If you need a technical security contact to complete a short questionnaire, loop in security@redwood.ai, but I've copied Laura from Legal and Marcus from Finance to help with PO/W9.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0142

Tessa / Marcus —

I reviewed the DPA and it's our current standard (v3.1). A couple of clarifications we should flag proactively to Uplift:
- Audit clause: we accept SOC 2 report in lieu of on-site vendor audits; we can provide a claims letter if needed.
- Subprocessor updates: we commit to 30 days notice of material subprocessor changes and post an updated CSV to the onboarding Drive folder.
- Data retention: default retention is application-level user data up to 365 days unless otherwise contracted.

Marcus, can you confirm invoice remit details and whether we can accept Uplift's standard PO terms (they typically send net 45) or ask them to change to net 30?

Emma / Dana — copying you so those points appear in the activation ticket. If Legal wants redlines, we'll accept them as comments in DocuSign and try to keep changes scoped to Sections 7–9.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Hi all —

Thanks — that's perfect. We received the DPA and subprocessors CSV. Uplift is okay taking SOC 2 link in place of an audit report; we'll attach the SOC 2 URL to our vendor record.

One more ask before we create the PO: can you confirm if Redwood accepts invoices addressed to Uplift Technology and whether invoices should reference our legal entity name (Uplift Technology, Inc.) or our procurement subsidiary (Uplift Tech Services LLC)? We usually push the billing entity into the PO.

We'll prepare a PO once we have that confirmation and the W9 (received). Expect PO in the next 24–48 hours.

Best,
